title: The Witch Who Would Not Be Read — Pit-Band Audio Cues

cues.description: Dramatic camp theatre-organ chord followed by low sneaky staccato misterioso loop for curtain opening & 11:00 setup
Sickly-sweet, slightly-too-polite 3/4 waltz (piano, celesta/music-box, pizzicato) in G minor for the Sensible Script
cues.source: Synthesized pit-band arrangement matching proto/index.html Act I waltz theme

cues.description: Opening run, dramatic organ blasts, and agitato passage from J.S. Bach's Toccata and Fugue in D minor, BWV 565 (Tamburini pipe organ)
cues.source: Wikimedia Commons File:Toccata_et_Fugue_BWV565.ogg (Tamburini organ performed by Ashtar Moira)
cues.license: Public domain (PD-old / personal recording released to public domain)
cues.attribution: J. S. Bach, Toccata and Fugue in D minor, BWV 565, performed on Tamburini organ by Ashtar Moira (Wikimedia Commons, Public Domain)

cues.description: Saint-Saens' Danse Macabre (playful xylophone bones & pizzicato strings)

cues.description: Edvard Grieg's In the Hall of the Mountain King, starting sneaky and accelerating into panic frenzy

cues.description: Slow, tender, warm music-box / celesta loop with 4.0s breath cycle (2s inhale, 2s exhale)

cues.source: Original synthesized pit-band pizzicato misterioso loop
